nodes.label: Assessment domain service (grading, shuffle, eligibility, schemas)
nodes.rationale: calcularNota trusts the isCorrect persisted by responder instead of re-comparing options, keeping the answer key server-side. Shuffling is deterministic: FNV-1a hash + mulberry32 PRNG + Fisher-Yates reproduce the same order from the same seed; the option-order seed derives from attemptId:questionId so reloading the page does not re-shuffle. Attempt lockout follows spec §6.6.

nodes.label: Deterministic seeded shuffle
nodes.rationale: FNV-1a + mulberry32 PRNG + Fisher-Yates make attempt ordering reproducible from a seed; the option-order seed derives from attemptId:questionId so reloads do not reshuffle.
